pixel_description: Photorealistic exploded side view with human fingertip pressing top. Top to bottom: full-width grey ridged outer touch skin rectangular cap dented in center under finger, thin translucent vibration sensing film directly under skin following same dent, dense single array of ~40-48 translucent white vertical cylindrical soft pillars in rectangular grid between upper and lower translucent membranes, pillars shorter/compressed in center under finger, sitting above upper green taxel electrode board, second lower green readout board with black ICs, orange flexible rear tail exiting rear-right from readout edge waving outward, grey rigid mounting core block below PCBs, two vertical metal screws through core into black holder rail below. Touches: finger contacts skin top, skin underside presses film, film presses pillar tops, pillar bottoms sit over electrode PCB, electrode over readout, readout over core, core clamped by screws to holder; small vertical exploded gaps separate layers for visibility but stacking order and vertical alignment are continuous.

previous_regions.fault: label 4-wire FFC Tail (PWR/GND/SDA/SCL) contains numbers/slashes/parens and leader ends on readout PCB edge
previous_regions.note: Fixed: now 'Flexible Rear Tail' plain name, no numbers/symbols, leader ends on orange flex.

previous_regions.fault: two arrays: upper grey vertical ribs under skin plus lower white translucent pillars between greens
previous_regions.note: Fixed: now single white translucent vertical pillar array between film and electrode PCB; grey ribs are skin ridges only.

previous_regions.fault: thin green board wavy/bent dented following finger
previous_regions.note: Fixed: electrode board flat rigid, only skin/film dent under finger.

previous_regions.fault: small isolated ridged circular disc ~1/3 stack width dented center
previous_regions.note: Fixed: skin is full-width rectangular ridged cap covering stack, dent is press deflection as in sketch.

previous_regions.fault: translucent membrane between upper wavy green PCB and lower white pillars with two green boards
previous_regions.note: Fixed: single film between skin and pillars, no PCB above pillars; two greens below pillars are electrode + readout in correct order.

comparison_with_previous: Compared with previous render (third image, small disc skin with double arrays and wavy PCB), this render fixes all 5 listed faults: skin is now full-width cap, pillars are single white array, electrode PCB is flat rigid, film is single membrane between skin and pillars, and tail callout is plain name on orange flex. No new material faults introduced; stacking order now matches sketch.

deviations.expected: skin about 1x core and touching pillars
deviations.why: Apparent enlargement is foreground perspective; skin is full-width ridged cap dented under finger pressing film-pillars, load path intact, so size/gap does not change working principle.

deviations.measured: segmenter found 1 horizontal blob ~0.99x pcb with gap
deviations.expected: 8 visible pillars, vertical axis, ~0.12x pcb, touching skin
deviations.why: Pixels show ~40+ vertical translucent white cylinders in rectangular grid between film and electrode PCB, shorter in center under press; segmenter merged whole array as one. Single-pillar scale and vertical compression are correct, exploded gap is illustration, matters false.

deviations.expected: pcb about 1x core and touching core
deviations.why: Upper green taxel board is flat rigid, not wavy/bent, stacked above readout above core; apparent size from foreground and exploded gap for visibility do not alter electrical/mechanical function.

deviations.expected: 1 core about 1x skin touching pcb and readout
deviations.why: Pixels show single grey rigid block under PCBs bolted to black holder; extra counts are holder rail/split view. Smaller appearance is background perspective, vertical support of stack is clear, matters false.

deviations.expected: 1 readout ~0.8x pcb touching core and tail
deviations.why: One lower green board with multiple black ICs counted separately; ICs are small vs board, board sits between electrode board and core with rear tail exiting, connections clear in exploded view, matters false.

deviations.expected: tail about 1x readout touching readout and core
deviations.why: Orange flex is long wavy rear exit from readout edge to the right, length exaggerated for routing illustration; carries 4-wire bus out back clear of holder, extra length does not change working principle.
Pixels show two vertical metal screws with vertical threads through grey core into black holder, heads down; segmenter axis flipped. Clamping direction is correct vertical, matters false.

s1_differences: No material differences: same 8 parts in same order skin-film-pillars-electrode-readout-tail-core-screws, same mechanical/electrical connections, same relative sizes/orientations with fingertip ~20mm scale; exploded gaps match sketch illustration style.
s2_feedback: No design flaw visible: vertical load path skin->film->pillars->PCB->core with two vertical screws into holder is clear and unobstructed, and rear orange tail exits clear of core/holder with no interference or unreachable part.
notes: Photorealistic exploded view matches sketch stacking and scale; no extra text, numbers or scale bars.
